title: ADORA - A randomised controlled trial to evaluate anticoagulant cessation after antiphospholipid autoantibodies loss in thrombotic antiphospholipid syndrome
official: ADORA - A randomised controlled trial to evaluate anticoagulant cessation after antiphospholipid autoantibodies loss in thrombotic antiphospholipid syndrome
summary: Main objective: to study whether anticoagulation cessation is non-inferior to anticoagulation maintenance regarding the risk of recurrent thrombosis after aPL loss in patients with thrombotic APS.
conditions: The population to be studied are thrombotic APS with a low-risk profile in whom anticoagulation withdrawal might be discussed because of aPL loss.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adults ≥ 18 years old
2. Signed written consent form
3. Primary or secondary thrombotic APS according to 2023 ACR/EULAR classification criteria
4. aPL antibodies loss of LA, aCL, and aβ2GPI antibodies - defined as a normalised level (< 99th percentile) - in at least two consecutive measurements with at least 12 months between each measurement including one negative measurement within the 3 months preceding inclusion
5. Long term (>12 months) VKAs therapy
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of severe venous thrombosis. Severe venous thrombosis including massive pulmonary embolism; chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension; hepatic, mesenteric, renal and/or cerebral venous thrombosis
2. Presence of a mechanical heart valve or any other medical condition requiring anticoagulation with a VKA
3. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
4. Subject deprived of freedom, subject under a legal protective measure
5. No affiliation to any health insurance system
6. Enrolment to another interventional study (clinical trial on medicinal product, medical device and interventional research involving human participants not concerning health product)
7. History of arterial thrombosis
8. History of recurrent venous thrombosis while receiving VKAs
9. History of catastrophic antiphospholipid syndrome (CAPS)
10. Triple aPL positivity
11. Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1 for each VKAs medicinal product
12. Malignant hypertension
13. Severe hepatic impairment
14. Active malignancy
